name: Bodhisattva
dimensions: Height 78 cm; Width 52 cm; Depth 38 cm
summary: A Bodhisattva is a being who delays enlightenment in order to help others achieve salvation. This figure is a rare example of a Bodhisattva made of cast iron, once stable enough to be displayed outdoors. The holes in the head were probably for insets of precious stones.
